biggest_catch: There is a $0 annual fee, so the $200 bonus is yours to keep net — but only purchases that actually post as net purchases count: cash equivalents, balance transfers, fees, interest, gambling, and returned purchases are all excluded.
catches: Only pursue spending you already planned to do — never overspend just to chase a bonus; buying things to hit a threshold wipes out the bonus math and is how people lose money on this.
Only net purchases that post to the account count — cash equivalents, balance transfers, fees, interest charges, gambling transactions, and returned purchases are excluded.
You must hit at least $500 in qualifying net purchases within three months of account opening.
Applying triggers a hard credit inquiry, which can temporarily dip your credit score by a few points.
The card's variable APR (around 20%+) will erase the entire bonus in a month or two if you carry a balance — pay the full statement balance every month.

steps: Go to the official Wells Fargo Active Cash page and read the $200 / $500 terms and the excluded purchase types.
Apply online and get approved; save your approval confirmation.
Spend at least $500 on qualifying net purchases — your already-planned spending — within three months of account opening.
Avoid cash equivalents, balance transfers, gambling, and other excluded transactions; they do not count toward the $500.
Pay the full statement balance every month so interest never eats the bonus.
Confirm the $200 posts within one to two billing periods after you qualify.
